parts.text: In this experiment, you are to investigate reflection in a plane mirror. Record all of your observations and answers on page 7 of the Answer Booklet. The ray trace sheet must be tied into the Answer Booklet in front of page 6 after you have completed the experiment. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 3.1. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Draw the line XA . Mark the position where the line XA cuts EF . Label this point Y .

parts.label: j
parts.text: (j) Measure and record the distances AY and YX .

parts.label: k
parts.text: (k) Theory predicts that AY = YX . Suggest a reason why, in spite of carrying out the experiment with care, your values of AY and YX may be slightly different.

parts.label: l
parts.text: (l) State and explain the reason for one precaution that you took to gain an accurate result. Tie your ray trace sheet in front of page 6 of the Answer Booklet.
